name: _template
notes: Copy this file to make a new script. Every step is one turn: the harness plays or presses it, then waits for the PBX to finish its next reply before moving on. Exactly one verb key per step - say, press, wait or hangup. Any {placeholder} in a value is filled from vars below, then overridden by --var on the command line. {phone} and {caller_id} always exist, so --dtmf and --caller-id reach this script without editing it.

steps.note: a wav in the audio dir (8000 Hz, mono, 16-bit)
DTMF digits, sent one at a time
seconds of silence - use it to test the re-ask timer
end the call instead of waiting out MAX_CALL_SECONDS
